description: This source file implements WiFi CSI (Channel State Information) motion detection and related management functions. It handles CSI session creation, enabling/disabling sessions, setting client MAC addresses, event handling for subscription and data collection, and communication over FIFO pipes for CSI data publishing. It also contains event callbacks for device connect/disconnect, and webconfig application of settings.

classes.name: csi_session_t
classes.description: Represents a CSI session with parameters like session number, interval, mac list, and FIFO descriptor.

classes.name: wifi_app_t
classes.description: Represents a WiFi application instance used for event handling and data management.
